summary: Google offers eligible college students one free year of Google AI Pro in the U.S. or Google AI Plus in over 140 eligible markets outside the U.S. The Plus offer excludes Bolivia, Albania, Canada, Macau, Hong Kong and Tunisia. Redeem by December 31, 2026 through the student offer flow. A valid payment method is required at signup. Unless canceled, Pro automatically renews at $19.99/month and Plus at $4.99/month or the local-currency equivalent after the trial. This is a back-to-school promotion announced by the official Gemini App account.
claim_steps: Visit https://gemini.google.com/students and follow the student redemption flow with your consumer Google account; do not assume a school-issued account automatically qualifies.

Check student and market eligibility and complete the verification requested in the offer flow. Pro is for eligible U.S. students; Plus excludes the U.S., Bolivia, Albania, Canada, Macau, Hong Kong and Tunisia.
Provide a valid payment method and redeem the one-year trial by December 31, 2026; enrollment is not automatic.
Cancel before the trial ends to avoid automatic renewal: $19.99/month for Pro or $4.99/month/local equivalent for Plus.

social_proof.author: Gemini
social_proof.text: Back-to-school season is here and starting today, eligible college students can get a full year of Gemini on us: US students: 1 year of Google AI Pro at no cost. 140+ countries: 1 year of Google AI Plus at no cost.

social_proof.title: College students get 12 months of Google AI free
social_proof.text: Redeem until December 31, 2026. Valid form of payment required at sign-up. Unless cancelled earlier, Google AI Pro will automatically charge $19.99/month after the trial ends. Eligible students in over 140 markets where Google AI Plus is available, except for in the U.S., Bolivia, Albania, Canada, Macau, Hong Kong, and Tunisia. Google AI Plus will automatically charge $4.99/month or local currency equivalent after the trial ends.
